python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv, io
data = """kind,line_id,description,quantity,unit_price
invoice,BI-I-1,Equipment service 1,2,315
invoice,BI-I-2,Equipment service 2,3,315
invoice,BI-I-3,Equipment service 3,4,315
purchase,BI-P-1,Warehouse fixture 1,3,210
purchase,BI-P-2,Warehouse fixture 2,4,210
purchase,BI-P-3,Warehouse fixture 3,5,210
"""
from decimal import Decimal
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data)))
inv=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='invoice']
pur=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='purchase']
def tot(rs): return sum(Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price']) for r in rs)
print("invoice lines:", len(inv), "subtotal:", tot(inv))
print("purchase lines:", len(pur), "excluded subtotal:", tot(pur))
EOF"}
